name: Pimozide
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Hepatic N-dealkylation is mainly catalyzed by CYP3A4, with smaller CYP1A2/CYP2D6 contributions. Elimination is mainly renal; the antipsychotic activity of the principal metabolites is undetermined.
